drafted.title: Audit log UI — `/o/[orgSlug]/audit` and `/admin/audit` with filters, diff view and CSV export
Scheduled announcements polish and notification delivery status pages

open_issues: Split (orchestrator decision 13): skeleton 6.2 → 6.2a (audit UI, CSV export, `@church/db` `queries/audit.ts`) and 6.2b (scheduled announcements polish + `/o/[orgSlug]/notifications` delivery status). Chain 3.6b → 6.2a → 6.2b; the skeleton's `depends_on: 3.6` is repointed to `3.6b` per G9's note; the assembler should place both after 6.1c (6.2b links to 5.3a's `/events` and 6.1b's `/surveys/[surveyId]` when present).

Names chosen for 6.2a (docs stop at `/audit`, `/admin/audit`): export routes `/o/[orgSlug]/audit/export` and `/admin/audit/export`, `packages/db/src/queries/audit.ts` (`listAuditLog`, `listAuditActors`, `countAuditSince`, `AUDITED_TABLES`, `AUDIT_ACTIONS`), `apps/web/src/features/audit/`, base64url keyset cursor (shared codec `packages/db/src/cursor.ts` from 6.2b on), UI deny-list `NEVER_RENDER_KEYS`, 7-day default on `/admin/audit` because `audit_log` only has the `(org_id, created_at desc)` index; a cross-org `audit_log (created_at desc)` index would need a `9996_*` migration — flagged, not added.

Names chosen for 6.2b (docs name no delivery status page): routes `/o/[orgSlug]/notifications` and `/notifications/[notificationId]`, `src/features/notifications/`, helpers `listNotifications`, `countNotificationsByStatus`, `rescheduleQueuedNotification` (service), `listDeliveriesForNotification` (service), `getNotificationForOrg`, Server Actions `rescheduleAnnouncementAction`, `publishAnnouncementNowAction`, `listDeliveriesAction`; `queryKeys.notifications.list/detail` added to 1.7a's key factory.

6.2b widens `notification_deliveries` visibility (super-only in RLS) to `announcements.*` holders via an org-checked service-client Server Action showing recipient display names and device platforms (never emails/tokens) — a product decision recorded for the founder to veto; if vetoed the detail page keeps only 3.6a's aggregate counts.

6.2b's `rescheduleQueuedNotification` is a service-client write to `notifications` from a Server Action (after the user-client `publish_at` update), closing the gap G9 documented (a push moved earlier waited for the old `scheduled_for`). G9 revisers may prefer to put it in 3.5a/3.6a; then 6.2b's Build item 2 shrinks to the UI actions.
6.2a and 6.2b both add tiles to `src/features/org/Dashboard.tsx` additively; critics should check neither prompt restyles the dashboard.
6.3, 6.4 and 6.5 are drafted in later runs; nothing here pre-empts their names except the note that a `9996_*` audit index could ride along with 6.3.
